name: Gen5W Split Screen Blocker
description: Removes the right-hand split screen and its slide-out tab from every screen. To turn it off: in HMG-API, open Mods, pick Gen5W Split Screen Blocker, switch it off and tap Apply changes. The split screen comes back at the next screen change, even if HMG-API shows Restart needed. To turn it back on: switch it on, tap Apply changes, then tap Restart unit. Runs only on the software builds it was checked on (Hyundai Ioniq 6, Kia Sportage, and Kia K5); on any other build it changes nothing.
